hero.name: Nathan Ridacker
hero.title: Custom Business Applications
hero.subtitle: Freelance developer building web and mobile apps tailored to the way you work: internal tools, back-offices, dashboards, field apps. React, Svelte & React Native.

about.title: Tools built around your business
about.body: An overflowing spreadsheet, off-the-shelf software that doesn't fit how you work, a process still handled by hand? I turn those needs into custom applications that are simple to use and easy to evolve. With 6 years of experience on demanding business applications in the finance sector, I support you from understanding the need all the way to production: scoping, mockups, web and mobile development, then ongoing support. One single point of contact who speaks your language as well as code.

services.title: What I can do for you

items.title: Internal tools & back-offices
items.description: Replace spreadsheets and manual data entry with an app designed for your team: customer, inventory, scheduling or case management.

items.title: Dashboards
items.description: Bring your data together and track your key metrics at a glance, with views tailored to each type of user.

items.title: Field mobile apps
items.description: iOS and Android apps for your teams on the move: data entry, job tracking, photos, checklists, straight from their phone.

items.title: App redesign & takeover
items.description: Is your tool getting old, or is its developer no longer available? I take over the existing code, modernise it and keep it evolving without starting from scratch.

photographer.title: Photographer Portfolio
photographer.description: Showcase site built with Svelte for a professional photographer. Organic warm design, serif typography, immersive gallery, optimised performance.

elderScrolls.title: Elder Scrolls Lore
elderScrolls.description: Trilingual (FR/EN/ES) encyclopedic wiki dedicated to the Tamriel lore, built with AI as an accelerator. I own the architecture, set the scope, review and validate; the AI produces code and content under control. Proof that well-supervised AI cuts delivery time and cost without sacrificing quality, an approach I bring to your projects.

karate.title: Karaté Club Manager
karate.description: Mobile business app for a karaté club: member management, belt progression and a calendar of upcoming sessions and events (seminars, competitions, gradings) with notification reminders. No more paper sheets and Excel files.

openspace.title: Virtual Open Space
openspace.description: Real-time pixel-art virtual office where employees navigate with custom avatars. Think Stardew Valley meets remote work.

items.quote: Nathan captured my world in a website that truly feels like me. Attentive, responsive and always giving sound advice on technical choices.
items.name: Florian Ridacker

items.quote: No more paper schedules: everyone sees the upcoming sessions on their phone, with a reminder so they don't forget, and tracking belt progression has never been easier.
items.name: First Last

karate_case.need: The club managed its members, session schedule and belt gradings on paper and in Excel files. Scattered information, hard to keep up to date and hardly accessible to members.
karate_case.solution: A mobile app that brings the club's day-to-day together, available anytime from a phone.

features.title: Sessions & reminders
features.description: Calendar of upcoming sessions, with notifications so nobody forgets.

features.title: Events
features.description: Upcoming seminars, competitions and gradings, in the same calendar.

karate_case.cta_text: Is your organisation or business still managing everything by hand? Let's talk about the tool that would save you time.
